# Donor Import Records

Future admitted donor records belong in this directory as one machine-readable JSON record per bounded import decision.

Before a record can be admitted it must:

1. pass the canonical donor import-record validator;
2. pass admission validation with dependency closure `COMPLETE`;
3. have no destination-path collision with another admitted record;
4. preserve explicit license/NOTICE/authority information;
5. carry verification and review evidence;
6. reconcile the deterministic root notice inventory.

There are currently no admitted donor records in this directory.
